versions.changelog:
- Updated CRON-PAYLOAD.md and README.md to reflect latest usage and configuration details.
- Improved example and documentation for config.json in templates. 
- No changes to core functionality or SKILL.md in this release.

Initial release of linkedin-monitor.

- Monitors LinkedIn inbox hourly, ensuring no duplicate notifications.
- Supports 4 progressive autonomy levels: monitor-only, draft/approve, simple auto-reply, full autonomy.
- Drafts replies in your personal communication style and alerts you to new conversations.
- Includes health checks and alerts for authentication or operational issues.
- Provides CLI commands for setup, manual checks, configuration, and reviewing activity/logs.
